name: Default
shortDescription: Regular expression code search across Git, Mercurial, SVN and Bazaar repositories, served through a web UI and a JSON API.

alerts.message: The repositories to index are listed in the mounted config.json, which starts with Hound's own source as an example. Edit it and redeploy to index your own code.
Hound has no login: anyone who can reach the domain can search every indexed repository.
